crossRefs.note: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.
translations.bsb: Then Saul hurled his spear at Jonathan to kill him. So Jonathan knew that his father was determined to kill David.
translations.kjv: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
translations.asv: And Saul cast his spear at him to smite him; whereby Jonathan knew that is was determined of his father to put David to death.
